name: Jackson Family
story: Mariah Jackson has sole custody of her daughter Madison Lowe. Madison's father, Craig Lowe, may check her in. Her uncle may not have contact.
testPurposes: Single parent whose child has a different last name.
Child with a legal note restricting contact.
Child who can be checked in by a parent in another family.

members.bio: Mariah is a single mom with sole custody of her daughter Madison. Madison's father, Craig Lowe, is allowed to check her in; another relative is not allowed contact, and that note appears on Madison's record.
Maddie (Madison Lowe) is seven. Her last name differs from her mom's, and her record carries a legal note about who may pick her up. Use her to test check-in security and authorized pickups.

attributes.LegalNotes: Frank Lowe (uncle) is not allowed to have contact.
